csv_scope_of_work: Previous design build award is not moving forward. Project has been broken into segments and being re-advertised. Design-Build scope encompasses the Main Span and Marine Approaches. The project involves a cable-stayed bridge with a main span of 1,665 feet (3,365' total), featuring a minimum clearance of 230 feet over the federal channel. The structure will incorporate a steel edge girder/floor beam system and vessel collision pier protection. The scope also includes approximately 660 feet of the south approach bridge over the river and approximately 1,560 feet of the north approach bridge over the river.
